description: Who's next? Let the wheel decide. Click Spin to pick from the people on the board, the stickies you select or a list you type, and everyone on the board watches the same wheel land on the same answer. You can also shuffle an order, split into even groups, roll dice, flip a coin or draw a warm-up question in English or Thai. Each result stays as a sticky. Made for standups, workshops, retros and classrooms.
